title: Agent image approval record
description: Machine-readable evidence that a digest-pinned agent image was built from locked immutable inputs and scanned. Only the final image@sha256 reference is the approved execution input; tags are never exposed as approved values.

source_commit.description: Full git commit SHA the pipeline inputs were taken from.

input_lock_sha256.description: SHA-256 of agent-images/images.lock at build time.

image.description: The approved reference MUST be the resolved image@sha256 digest, never a tag. The pattern rejects any reference that does not end in @<64-hex-digest> (optionally with the sha256: algorithm prefix).

report.description: Path to the Trivy JSON report.

status.description: pending_scan: build complete, scan not yet run. approved: scan passed and the digest is publishable. blocked: the scan policy failed; publication is blocked.
